notes: LIKELY SURNAME-SWAPPED MERGE ARTIFACT (research 2026-07-03): as recorded, this 'Peleg Coffin' has parent William Bunker, spouse 'Susannah Bunker' (I182382755270), and child 'Judith Mary Bunker' — genealogically incoherent, since a son of William BUNKER would not carry the surname COFFIN. Web sources (Geni 'Peleg Bunker,' billputman.com Bunker genealogy) instead document a Peleg BUNKER (son of William Bunker, b. 1 Dec 1676, d. 1 Jun 1730) who married Susanna(h) COFFIN — daughter of Stephen Coffin and Mary Bunker — on 9 Jan 1700 at Nantucket; their daughter was Judith Bunker (correctly carrying father Peleg Bunker's surname). This record's name and its spouse's name (I182382755270) appear to have had their surnames swapped/overwritten upstream. Do not confuse with the unrelated Congressman Peleg Coffin Jr. (1756–1805) of Nantucket/Portland, ME, who also turned up in searches.
